title: Mexican drug kingpin depicted in ‘Narcos’ dies in prison
summary_full: Miguel Ángel Félix Gallardo was the U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration’s most wanted man in Mexico after the 1985 torture-murder of a DEA agent.
